extracted.intended_audience: writers, poets, critics, and readers interested in developing a native American literature and cultural critics of literature
extracted.subtask_description: Prescriptive guidance for creating and evaluating a native, democratic American literature — its themes, tone, sources, and moral aims, contrasted with imported or sensational work. Aimed at authors and critics who would shape a national literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Native originality / American expression-spirit
rubrics_metrics.description: Literature must evidence a native expression-spirit, self-contained and different from others — 'a native expression-spirit, getting into form, adult, and through mentality, for these States, self-contain'd, different from others'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek original authorship and forms that arise from American life rather than imitating foreign models; authenticity may come from western settlers, mechanics, miners, boatmen, farmers, local songs, slang, or regional idioms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Democratic inclusiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: The new standard must be 'broad enough for all, eligible to every farmer and mechanic--to the female equally with the male'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce literature that is accessible to and representative of all social classes, sexes, and ordinary occupations rather than literature exclusive to elites or aristocratic models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character over polish or erudition
rubrics_metrics.description: Character will be a main requirement, and not merely erudition or elegance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value works and authors that manifest strong, developed personalities and moral depth rather than technical polish, fashionable refinement, or mere scholarly display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration with and restoration of Nature
rubrics_metrics.description: Nature, true Nature, and the true idea of Nature... must, above all, become fully restored, enlarged, and must furnish the pervading atmosphere to poems, and the test of all high literary and esthetic compositions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ground literature in truthful relationships with landscape, outdoor life, and natural perception; favor 'al fresco' healthful tones and the spirit of nature as central motifs and tests of quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cheerful simplicity and absence of morbid tone
rubrics_metrics.description: The great literatus will be known...by his cheerful simplicity, his adherence to natural standards, his limitless faith in God, his reverence, and by the absence in him of doubt, ennui, burlesque, persiflage, or any strain'd and temporary fashion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid morbid sophistication, lurid or maleficent themes, excessive doubt or cynical persiflage; cultivate a buoyant, healthy, and reverent tone in line with democratic optimism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service to moral civilization / conscience
rubrics_metrics.description: The very highest height of literature... is the formulation, expression, and aidancy of moral civilization — 'absolute Conscience, moral soundness, Justice.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for literature that furthers moral insight, justice, and conscience; treat moral seriousness as a central evaluative criterion, beyond mere aesthetic effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation of original national archetypes
rubrics_metrics.description: A nation needs 'national, original archetypes in literature' to vitalize and give form to its political and material achievements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate archetypal figures, scenes, and modes that encapsulate the American experience and will endure as national symbols in literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejecting imported feudal/aristocratic character-types
rubrics_metrics.description: America must cease to recognize a theory of character grown of feudal aristocracies... or from any ultramarine, full-dress formulas of culture, polish, caste, &c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supervise and adapt respected elements of culture but do not subordinate American literary character to old-world aristocratic models; combine perennial elements into forms appropriate to democratic life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement with science and the modern (forward-looking)
rubrics_metrics.description: America demands a poetry that is bold, modern, and all-surrounding and kosmical... It must in no respect ignore science or the modern, but inspire itself with science and the modern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate contemporary scientific knowledge, modern sensibilities, and a forward-looking vision rather than retreating into past models or nostalgic imitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portrayal of interior/spiritual life for permanence
rubrics_metrics.description: To workmen portraying interior or spiritual life... they last forever; interior and spiritual portrayals make for lasting literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize psychological depth, spiritual interiority, and character-development that endures, rather than transient sensational incident designed only to titillate immediate appetites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use local materials, voices, and idioms
rubrics_metrics.description: Genuine American aroma may arrive... in some western idiom, Michigan or Tennessee repartee... Manhattan, Boston, Philadelphia or Baltimore mechanic... Maine woods... California miner... boatmen of the lakes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek and elevate regionally specific language, songs, slang, and local incidents as sources of authentic literary material and voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid theatrical dribble, sensationalism, and mere amusement
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'dribble' of much drama and the sensational appetite of novels do not fulfil the needs of the land; much current literature aims only 'to amuse, to titillate, to pass away time.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critically reject works that prioritize ephemeral amusement, sensational incident, or fashionable titillation; demand seriousness and purposeful conception in drama and fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bold, kosmical scope and self-faith
rubrics_metrics.description: America demands a poetry that is bold, modern, and all-surrounding and kosmical... it must have entire faith in itself, and the products of its own democratic spirit only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage expansive, ambitious works that claim loftiness (kosmic scope) and that trust American democratic instincts rather than seeking validation from European models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primacy of the mind in vitalizing materials
rubrics_metrics.description: All the objective grandeurs of the world... yield themselves up, and depend on mentality alone. The mind... builds the permanent edifice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat imaginative intelligence — the shaping mind — as the agent that turns raw national materials into meaningful literature; artistic conception is central to value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim for permanence and transmission across ages
rubrics_metrics.description: Only a few immortal compositions... 'tiny ships' carry the essence of a people across time; literature should supply what is indispensable and highest for a nation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strive for works that will transmit a nation's deepest experiences and values through time — inscriptions that encapsulate manners, idioms, beliefs, and spiritual meanings rather than ephemeral prints.
